review.notes: All 39 physical pages diffed word-by-word (case/punctuation-normalized) against the OCR markdown; physical pages 13, 23, 25, 26, 27 and 33 rendered and visually inspected (300 dpi crops of the identifier/table areas, 150 dpi page context). The document contains no code fences, so no fence-balance issues. Nearly every diff hit is soft-hyphen splitting in the PDF text layer that the OCR joined correctly (e.g. 'perfor mance', 'kup puswamy', 'wood island' extracted without underscores); the glued italic run on p.14 ('OXE-Ramen data is a subset ... and total number of episodes') is present in the OCR with correct spacing. Tables S1, S2, S5, S6 and S7 were spot-checked cell-by-cell against renders and match, including the S6 station rollouts (49/490/196/305/533/496/260/229). The PDF prints identifiers such as wood_island, lbm_eval and the TFDS dataset names with real underscores (LaTeX \texttt), so the OCR's underscore spellings and \_ escapes that render as underscores were kept; only the spurious spaces inside lbm_eval and inside four Table S7 dataset names were repaired. Task-name run-in headings (TurnLargeContainerUpsideDown etc.) are printed as bold run-in titles with rules on p.25, so the OCR's heading promotion matches the print; the sentence tail 'are shown below:' does not.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.24-25: the sentence 'The task-specific predicates for these tasks are shown below:' starts at the bottom of p.24 and its tail 'are shown below:' prints at the top of p.25 as plain paragraph text, followed by the bold predicate-block titles (TurnLargeContainerUpsideDown, ...). The OCR promoted only the sentence tail to a '## ' heading; removed the spurious heading marker so the tail stays prose.

Rendered physical p.13 (300 dpi) prints 'our simulation benchmark, lbm_eval, which is built on top of Drake [86]. lbm_eval uses curated assets' and physical p.16 prints 'all part of lbm_eval.' in monospace with an underscore and no space. Two of the OCR occurrences (physical p.13 context) insert a space before the escaped underscore, rendering 'lbm _eval'; the third is in the Evaluation Tasks paragraph (physical p.16 context). Removed the spurious space, keeping the OCR's own \_ escape spelling used elsewhere in the document (lbm_robot, lbm_eval's).

Rendered physical p.33 Table S7 prints the data source name as the single token furniture_bench_dataset_converted_externally_to_rlds with underscores throughout and lowercase 'converted'; the OCR cell split it with a space and capitalized 'Converted'.
Rendered physical p.33 Table S7 prints nyu_franka_play_dataset_converted_externally_to_rlds as one underscore token; the OCR cell inserted a space and capitalized 'Converted'.
Rendered physical p.33 Table S7 prints stanford_hydra_dataset_converted_externally_to_rlds as one underscore token; the OCR cell inserted a space and capitalized 'Converted'.
Rendered physical p.33 Table S7 prints utokyo_xarm_pick_and_place_converted_externally_to_rlds as one underscore token; the OCR cell inserted a space and capitalized 'Converted'.
